description: Records that the chosen campaign recipients asked to stop, as Opt out on the send queue does: scope 'all' stops every message, 'marketing' stops campaigns only; a short reason is required. It is a one-way stop and sends nothing. taskIds are the selected campaign step tasks from the send queue. Pass the same idempotency_key when retrying.

idempotency_key.description: Your id for this operation (8-128 of A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ : -). Reuse it on every retry of the same operation; use a new one for a new operation.

name: opt_out_campaign_recipients
title: Opt campaign recipients out
